module: Flowgraph node "Set Camera FOV" (repeat_instant category, camera color/icon). Input pin: value (number), the field of view in degrees. On each execution (work), switches to the free camera if not already, then calls core_camera.setFOV(0, value). When the graph starts it stores the current FOV (core_camera.getFovDeg) and restores it on stop.
notes: If the value pin has no value, core_camera.setFOV is still called with nil (no guard in the code).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Forces the free camera (commands.setFreeCamera) if needed, then applies the FOV of the value pin via core_camera.setFOV(0, ...).

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the graph starts: stores the current FOV in self._storedFov.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the graph stops: restores the stored FOV then forgets it.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the FOV value (2 decimals) in the middle of the node in the editor.
